Paper 01

Gelina: Unified Speech and Gesture Synthesis via Interleaved Token Prediction

Téo Guichoux, Théodor Lemerle, Shivam Mehta, Gustav Eje Henter, Jonas Beskow, Laure Soulier, Catherine Pelachaud, Nicolas Obin

ICASSP · 2026

PDF ↗ DOI ↗ Code ↗

In this paper, we introduce Gelina, a discrete autoregressive model for the joint synthesis of speech and gestures. This webpage provides the supplementary materials, videos and others associated with the paper.
